balls.text: SIX to end the innings! Twenty off the final over and RR have managed to reach 159 for 6. Banged in short on middle stump, he swings, gets a bit of a top-edge but manages enough power to clear deep backward square leg. Mayank has been peppered for 56 off his four overs.
On a length on middle and leg, he heaves this to the left of Badoni at deep backward square for two more.
A misfield gives Jadeja two more. Sharp good length ball on his hips at 144.1kph. He heaves this to deep backward square leg, where Badoni misfields and allows an extra run
Four more! Another offcutter bowled back of a length ball outside off, he flat-bats to the left of mid-off
On-pace back of a length ball on off, he is hurried into the pull as he bunts to the on-side but still gets two runs
The first boundary of Jadeja's innings. Slower back of a length ball right in Jadeja's arc on off, he pulls through midwicket with ferocity
Oh, what a shot! Prince has nailed his yorker on off stump, but Dubey gets his bat down in time and squeezes in the gap between backward point and short third

Nails the yorker. Jadeja is staying legside of the ball but Prince follows him outside leg stump and hits him on the foot as he misses the flick. The ball goes to the right of Pant, who dives, falls and hurts his nose once more. Hang on, LSG have reviewed... for this! The ball has pitched well outside leg, the impact is well outside leg and would have missed another set of stumps
Hits him high on the bat but the ball eludes short midwicket. Hurries him with a pacy back of a length ball on middle, He pulls but the ball gets big on him and goes over Shami
Fullish outside off stump, he slices to deep backward point
Too full and duly punished. The mid-off is up so that is an easy boundary for Dubey. Outside off, in his slot, he clears his front leg and thumps it all along the turf to the left of mid-off
Banged in short angling away from Jadeja at 140kph, he misses the ramp
Ends his spell with a skiddy quick length ball outside off that is punched to long-off

First four off Rathi this evening. Goes length and slower now at 91.9kph away from Shubam's arc outside off. He looks to go inside-out over covers, gets a thick outside edge that flies over short third's head
Darted on the shorter side again at 99kph outside off stump, he pulls to wide long-on
Flatter 99kph short of a length ball away from Jadeja outside off, he slaps it to Pooran at sweeper cover
Short and very wide at 97kph away from Jadeja's hitting arc. He still gets enough power on the thrash to the right of sweeper cover for two
Pushed quicker angling across the batter, who stays back and slaps to deep cover
On-pace fuller-length ball on middle stump at 134.4kph. He neatly clips through midwicket for a couple of runs. Mohsin ends his four overs, with excellent figures of 2 for 17
Another slower offcutter at 123.4kph, was a length ball on middle and leg, he gets across and works this to deep backward square leg
Slower 120.9kph short of a length offcutter outside off, Jadeja pulls to deep midwicket
Fuller 139kph delivery on the stumps, Dubey pushes to long-on
Backs away outside leg but Mohsin spots him early and follows him with a slower back of a length. Jadeja is cramped up for room and can only turn this towards deep midwicket
Slower back of  length ball outside off, he pushes to backward point
Length ball around off stump, he opens the face of the bat and pushes to backward point

Straight down deep third's throat and Prince Yadav's excellent season continues. Slower bouncer outside off at 117kph, he backs away and looks to ramp that fine. But the off-pace ball means he has to generate all the pace. Isn't able to and Mohsin takes a simple catch
Fuller on the stumps, he flicks to midwicket
Sharp back of a length ball on middle and leg, he pulls to deep backward square leg
Banged in short on middle, he pulls to deep backward square leg for a couple of runs
Back of a length ball angling across Jadeja who pats to backward point
Pacy good length ball outside off, he throws his bat at it, gets a thick outside edge that flies to the left of deep third

Oh, dear me! It's all happening. Has Ferreira run himself out there? No, he isn't because Pant has knocked the bails beforehand and the throw was off the mark as well. Slower short of a good length ball on middle, he turns this to deep backward square leg. Ferreira hares off for the second but Jadeja isn't going anywhere. Ferreira is next to Jadeja but Pooran's throw is wide. Pant, in trying to retrieve that throw knocks off the bails. There is still time to run out Ferreira who makes a scramble back. The fielder has the presence of mind to uproot the stump, but doesn't uproot the stump with which he held the ball. Ferreira dives and eventually makes it in. What a mess! The end result is that Ferreira is safe

Short and wide and more good fielding from LSG. Angled well outside off stump, giving Jadeja lots of room. He thrashes the cut to the right of Rathi at deep backward point who dives acrobatically and saves two
Slower length ball at 108.7kph on middle stump, he works this to the left of long-on for a couple of runs
Cranks up the pace to 149.4kph with the short of a good length ball on middle and leg. Ferreira is rushed into the pull as he pulls towards deep midwicket
Too full outside off stump at 148.4kph outside off, Ferrerira creams this through covers but Pooran (he's everywhere) dives to his right at deep cover and keeps the batters down to two
Skiddy length ball on middle and leg, he ticks this to long-on
Pushed quicker on off stump, he pushes to long-off with a straight face of the  bat

Oof, just short of Pooran at deep midwicket and that he's managed to rein that in shows his athleticism. Dragged down on off stump, he pulls hard and flat to Pooran. The ball is dying in on him, but he dives forward and collects on the volley.
In the slot on middle stump, he looks to heave that away, but only gets it off the inside-half of the bat to midwicket
Lovely fielding by Pooran at deep midwicket. Short on middle and leg, he hops back and pulls with power to the right of Pooran. He dives and saves two
Slower through the air at 87.6kph spinning away from Jadeja on off stump, he prods forward and eases to long-off
Nice work by Rathi at midwicket. Short ball outside off, Ferreira pulls but right of the toe-end of the bat to the left of Rathi, who dives and saves at least a couple of runs
Banged in short shoulder-high on middle stump, he pulls to deep backward square leg
Goes full now on off stump, he presents the full face of the bat but only times this neatly to mid-off
Hard length angling back into Jadeja who mistimes back to the bowler
Short of a good length ball around off stump, he bunts this to long-on

Oh, Mayank! He's misjudged a catch in the deep and ends up conceding a four. Banged in short on off stump, Ferreira pulls and doesn't get a clean enough connection. Mayank at deep backward square leg, runs in when he should have been right on the edge of the boundary, where it would have been a simple catch. He leaps but the ball flies over his head. Shami is unimpressed. It is also the short side of the boundary, so not sure why Mayank was in.
Down leg but Jadeja can't get that away. Quicker and on his pads, he only tickles it straight to short fine leg
Flatter and marginally shortish outside off stump, he rocks back but only mistimes to long-off
Quicker and fuller on middle stump, he turns it to the right of short fine leg
Flatter length ball on middle and leg, works this to the left of a diving midwicket
Skiddy length ball coming back into Ferreira, he looks to work this away and is hit on the pad.
Fuller outside off, he looks for a drive, gets a thick inside-edge back onto his body
Sharp back of a length ball at 139.7kph on his hips, Ferreira pulls to deep backward square leg
Short of a good length ball on middle and leg, he works this to deep backward square leg
Banged in short on off stump, he pulls through midwicket to get off the mark
Oof, cuts him into half. Pacy back of a length ball just outside off stump. Ferreira is beaten on the inside-edge

Oh, LSG definitely on top, now. Mohsin returns and takes out Hetmyer. Back of a length ball just around off stump at 139.6kph. The angle back in troubles Hetmyer, who looks to turn this to the on-side, gets a big leading that pops straight up with Prince taking a simple enough catch at mid-off
On a length on middle and leg, he turns this to deep midwicket
Drives the full ball on off to cover. Three slower ones to finish. 115ks
Slow again? Yep, 116ks. Length outside off, guided to backward point
Change of pace now. 114ks length ball just outside off, looks to caress it behind point. Under-edges it to the pitch behind
Down the ground this time. Change of length again, Hetmyer isn't pre-meditating, gets forward and drives the 146ks fullish ball straight of mid-off
Goes short and gets pulled. 145ks bouncer at the left shoulder, Hetmyer ready for the change in length, gets it into the ground through midwicket

Wicket last ball but Hetmyer isn't bothered. Flicks the 149ks back of length ball on middle like it was down leg. Bente the back knee to get low and flick it 82 metres over backward square. Looked like a crowd catch

Helicopter flies only till long-on! Parag falls cheaply again, this time to a hittable ball. Seam-up 139ks pitched up on on off. Parag got still and wristed the helicopter through and through, bat-face may have been a touch too open and he ended up getting up too much height. Pooran took the catch and threw it right up too.
Fuller side of length on off, Parag keeps the bat low and vertical as he angling it back late. Guides it to backward point
Full on off, 138ks, flicked to deep midwicket
Into the stumps off a length, worked back to the bowler
Under-edge goes below, Hetmyer looks back wondering if it was going towards the stumps. Turns out not. Length ball outside off, he looked to dab it towards backward point
Length around off, 137ks, Parag improving that slice to deep third after being beaten earlier
Full on leg, 96ks, flicked with a check to long-on
Flat on a length just outside off, punched to cover. 94ks
Slightly short outside off, 92ks, pulled to long-on
Full on leg, 95ks, leading edge off the flick goes to long-off

Length on leg stump, flicked towards long-on... and Markram sends in a direct hit! Hetmyer rushed for the last-half of the second run but was he slow before? Geez, this looks tough. It's a matter of half a frame. Ball is on the tip of the outer end of the crease (from Hetmyer's pov) as the bail starts to light up. Third umpire gives him the benefit of the doubt. Bat may have been millimetres in if at all
Length on middle and off, flicked to deep midwicket. 90ks
Trash ball, duly punished. 137ks half-volley on the outer-side of the pads, Parag flicked it sweetly over long leg as Mayank grimaced. Timeout
Slower one looped to a full length just outside off. Jammed down. 110ks
Parag beaten on the upper cut this time. Looked to sway back and hit it off the back shoulder. 136ks
Bouncer around head-height, pulled into the ground through forward square leg. 144ks
Beaten. 147ks fullish length ball outside off, Hetmyer looked to flash it through point
Down leg. Goes past the pull. 143ks shortish and goes around rib-height. Hetmyer swivelled out of the way there
Half-volley to start. 141ks outside off, punched through cover, beats the infielder. There is sweeper cover
Length outside off, guided to deep third

Prince seems to have saved six at deep third Yes. He jumped, both feet up, back and patted the ball in before both his hands hit the grass on the other side of the boundary. Brilliant. Was a shortish ball going away outside off, Parag played the upper cut with the bat over shoulder, facing third
Almost guided to the keeper. 137ks length ball angling away just outside off, Parag waited for it to pass him before trying to guide it towards third
Mid-on in play? No, well over him. Parag flat-batting the pull, off the bottom of the bat but the fielder was close and that just cleared the infield
Length around off, 139ks, flicked to midwicket
Fullish length ball on off, defended off side of the pitch
Fullish just outside off, 140ks, punched to cover
Touch back of a length on off, 137ks, punched to cover
Fullish around off, defended to cover
Touch wider, edge of full and length. Let go, looked to shape away a touch. Shami and Parag look at each other and smile
Length in the channel, let go. Good carry to the keeper. 139ks
Overpitched, this is on the pads and flicked away. 139ks but it's a freebie on the shin. Hit into the ground
Hat-trick ball goes down leg. Full and doesn't swing. 138ks, goes past the leg glance

Should be out. Rathi takes a great catch! Not Sooryavanshi's day, the first big hit he attempts, he's gone. It's his shot to be fair, the long hit off the front foot over long-on but the fullish length ball at 142ks rose and took the outer-half of the bat. Ball went high, two infielders were running back from cover, Rathi was on the run as he judged it well and took it around his chest. Mohsin delighted as are LSG
Almost nicked off! Nothing shot from Sooryavanshi as he stands still and looks to guide it to third. Bat went left to right as the wobble ball went off a length towards fifth stump
Slot ball. Make that full under these circumstances. On leg stump, 142ks but no sideways movement, punched down the pitch
More caution from Sooryavanshi. Punches the fullish length ball from off stump to midwicket
Sooryavanshi doesn't get his front foot across as he defends to cover. He was on middle and leg as the length ball arrived on leg
Back of length around off, stabbed off the back foot towards backward point. 141k s

Shami Test-ifies T20s to nick off Jurel. Day one, first session, angle in towards leg before swerving away late. Jurel kept his hands close but left the bat-face slightly open. The 136ks ball took the outside edge and went to Pant. Shami will be on a hat-trick at the start of his next over

Whoa, Jaiswal's been bounced out! Wasn't sure if he hit it at first but there was glove on it. Pant jumped high and took it with the tip of his right hand. Snorter from Shami, 141ks, shortish and zipping over leg. Jaiswal swivelled, got his shoulders across to get inside the line for the hook. Ball was just over the shoulder as it rushed past the bat and took the glove
Still wide. Jaiswal gets stable and drives it up and over mid-off. Got it slightly low but enough for there to be no danger
Angle usage. Jaiswal waits for the length ball to come in towards him, opens the face late and slices it through to the deep-third boundary
Jaiswal too good to miss out twice. Same length, a touch straighter. Jaiswal still has ample time to carve it with the weight balanced nicely. Clears point
Beaten. Seam-up but seemed to swerve away late. Fuller side of length, Jaiswal took a small stride across and looked to belt it through cover

Hurried. Sooryavanshi wanted to pull that at first but the shortish ball burst through around shoulder-height. Went away just around off as the batter yanked his neck leg side. Good finish from Prince
Good pacy bouncer, seemed too high. Not given wide. 136ks over leg, sprung off the pitch at pace, Sooryavanshi went down for the full lunge, kept his hands relatively low too
Bowler lucky. That could've beaten fine leg easily, he was wide and it went right to him. 139ks length ball down leg, glanced
Width and the wrists are on show again. A bit of whiplash emerges as Sooryavanshi cuts it from hip-height through point
Whippity whip. Nice arc on the back lift and then an eased flick off a half-volley length. Uses the in-swing to hit it through midwicket. First-ball four to get off the mark
One run turns into five. Square leg moved left as the length ball was flicked. Mohsin wound up and flung it hard. Missed the striker's stumps, throw too quick for the back-up around point
Length outside off, cut to deep third. Sooryavanshi will be off-strike for a while
Length in the channel, let go. Swings as it approaches the keeper
Glanced fine, beats deep fine leg. He ran left and the ball bounced off his hand over the boundary. Was a length ball on the pads. Swung in to make matters worse
Length on leg, 136ks. Went straight. Beats the flick and deflects off the top of the pad towards backward point
Very wide outside off. Jaiswal walks down at pace before leaving
Pitched up just outside off, 138ks, goes away and is let go

Two noises but is it bat and pad? Shami confident, goes for a chat with Pant. No review. Fullish length ball on leg, came in a bit. Jaiswal went for the flick. Bat hit pad and the ball hit high on the front pad, Hawk-Eye says it'd be going over
Swing in but goes down leg. On a length, went in and past the leg glance. 137ks

THE MIDDLE STUMP IS FLATTENED! RR win by 40 runs in what has a defensive masterclass from the bowlers. Archer bowls this full, quick and on the base of middle stump. Mohsin misses and the stumps are left in a mess. RR back to winning ways, LSG lose a fourth-straight game.
Backs away to the fuller-length ball on leg stump, he backs away and defends to the bowler
Full and angling into Mohsin on the stumps, he defends

AN ABSOLUTE STUNNER FROM JUREL! What a 'keeper this man is! On a length outside off, Mayank pushes at it, gets a thick outside that flies to the right of Jurel, who flies to his right and takes a one-handed specky almost behind him
On a length outside off stump, Mayank stays legside of the ball, opens the face of the bat and guides to the right of deep third
Starts off with a snorter outside off. A short ball aiming for Rathi's head on off. He gets his gloves high up to protect his face and manages a thick outside edge to deep third
Hard length to end the over. Was the slower back of a length ball outside off, he mistimes back to the bowler
Good deception. Slower length ball outside off, Mayank looks to smash that across the line, can only get a thick outside edge to short third
Pinpoint yorker on off stump at 138.4kph, he somehow digs this out to deep backward square leg
The leg stump goes flop! Nails the yorker at 136kph on leg, Shami backs away, misses and sees his leg stump flattened
Back of a length ball on off stump, he opens the face of the bat and guides to deep third
On a length down leg, called a wide

Mukul falls! Is that the game for RR? Pacy back of a length ball outside off stump at 133kph. The ball gets big on Mukul as he just about looks to flat bat it. Gets it high on the bat, with the ball lobbing to Parag at extra cover who dives low and takes a good catch
In Shami's arc, that goes goes out of the park. He was just waiting for that! Slower length ball at 119kph on middle and leg, Shami clears his front leg and smacks the bones out of it over corner
Another slower length delivery angling across Shami outside off, he feels for it and is beaten
Just short! Deceives Shami all ends up with the slower offcutter at 121kph well outside off. He almost chips this to extra cover

Goes high, very high and Parag takes a comfortable catch running back from extra cover. Parag celebrates, Burger celebrates and RR are on a high. Slower 120.3kph offcutter angling well across Marsh outside off. He looks to loft that over covers but the angle doesn't allow him any power. He ends up skewing it straight up and Parag does the rest
Fullish in length angling across Marsh, was another slower ball at 122kph. Marsh mistimes to extra cover
First fifty for Marsh this season, off 39 balls! Slower back of a length ball outside off angling away from Marsh, who stays still and flat-bats over long-off
That's a shot-and-a-half! Mukul into the act early! Googly bowled at pace into Mukul who lines Bishnoi and smacks him across the line deeeeep over midwicket.
Darted at 108kph on a length just on off, Marsh stays legside of the ball and opens the face of the bat to deep point
Keeps the length ball on off stump, he ticks this to the left of midwicket for a run

You miss, I hit... Himmat does miss and Bishnoi does hit. He looks back towards the LSG dugout and signs the wicket in his book much like Rathi. Slider bowled at 107kph on off stump. Himmat looks to bash that across the line, misses and his offstump is flattened
Flatter length ball on the stumps, he gets a thick inside-edge onto pad as they take a quick run
Flatter and shorter on off stump, he flat-bats to wide long-on
Flatter outside off, he pushes with an open face of the bat behind square on the offside
Flatter on off and middle stump, he defends back towards the bowler
Oof, what a shot from Himmat! Jumps down the track to the tossed up outside off, he charges down the track and goes inside out over covers for a huge six
Flatter on the fuller side outside off, Himmat looks for a reverse and misses. Jurel misses the ball but don't think Himmat lost his balance

Huge appeal for lbw. Not given. Will they review? Nope. Flatter length ball on off stump, he sweeps, misses and is struck on the pad. Was the impact just outside? Yes, it was. The ball rolls to short third
Darted outside off, was on a length outside off, he pushes this firmly to the right of Parag who dives full-length and saves a run
Flatter but well outside off stump, called a wide
Five slower balls that over and Marsh ends with another run. Slower short of a length ball well outside off stump, he waits for it and pulls to deep midwicket
Another offcutter, another pull, another single. Slower back of a length ball on off stump, he pulls gets that to cow corner
Ah, misses out! Juicy shin-high full toss on his pad, he could have hit that anywhere, but misses the flick. The ball hits his pad to short fine leg
Dealing exclusively in offcutter this over so far. Bowled at 106.7kph just outside off stump, Himmat adjusts and pulls to deep midwicket
Another offcutter bowled back of a length on off stump, Marsh mistimes his pull to deep midwicket
Slower length ball at 120kph on middle stump, he turns this to deep square leg  for a run
Short and wide outside off, he hangs back and slaps the cut to deep extra cover
Quicker just outside off, he pushes to short third and sets off
Flatter length ball on off stump, he pushes to covers for a run. Some hesitation but no harm done
Darted on off stump, he heaves this to the legside for a run
Short, wide and hammered for back to back fours. Very wide outside off, he slaps that hard and flat through covers where a misfield from Parag gives away a four
Sweeps hard, sweeps flat and finds the gap. Fullish outside off stump, he bends down on one knee and hammers the sweep in the gap between deep midwicket and deep square leg
Length just outside off, guided to point
Fullish on off, defended towards cover
Touch fuller. Lands on leg and slides down leg. Himmat raises his bat to let the ball go
French cut to short fine leg. Marsh looked to defend straight, length ball went off the inside edge to short fine leg
Fullish 96ks ball at the stumps, defended towards mid-on
Shortish ball on leg, not much bounce, pulled through forward square leg
Fullish length ball just outside off, pushed to cover for a quick single
Fullish outside off, looks to drive hard through cover. Edges to short third
Full on leg, flicked to long-on

Pooran's first six-hitting attempt ends the innings. Length ball from around the wicket lands around off and angles away, the stock ball didn't turn or bounce much. Pooran went for a cross-bat swipe across the line and got it off the upper-half of the bat. Finds long-on. 99ks. Jadeja signals to Pooran that he has him in his pocket
Length on leg, flicked through midwicket
Wide on a length, Pooran shapes to cut before letting go
Length on leg, flicked through forward square leg
Wide and shortish, cut to deep point
Very wide on a length, cut to cover
Touch back of length outisde off, cut to cover

Very wide on a length, the angle keeps taking it away. Pooran takes the front foot across and is beaten on the cut. Bishnoi wants this checked for wide, Jurel and the captain agree. Oh wait, looks like the review was for a catch. Ball went just past the toe of the bat
Back of length on leg, 94ks, flicked off the back foot to long-on
Good fielding in the deep. Saves a bad ball from going for four. Very short and flat on leg, pulled to deep-backward square's right
Wide on a shortish length, 94ks, cut to cover's left. Diving half-stop keeps it to one
Touch shorter on leg, pulled to deep-backward square
Pushes it towards cover, can't pinch one
Length outside off, slapped off the back foot to long-off
Length just outside off, flicked to deep midwicket
Touch shorter on the same line, flicked to deep midwicket. 96ks
Length on off, square driven to point
Pooran pierces the gap at extra cover. He's working his way back to form with orthodox shots. 137ks full ball just outisde off, Pooran lunges across and drives it with a late check. Timeout
Back of length outside off, 139ks, under-edges a cut back to the bowler
Slow bouncer takes an age to rise around chest-height, Pooran crouches a bit and pulls into the ground behind square
Pitched up just outside off, defended to cover
Little bounce on that back of length ball outside off. Square driven to deep point. 135ks
Touch fuller than length outside off, 135ks, pushed to cover
145ks length ball touch wider, punched to cover
Great reply from Burger. Slight wobble on the fullish length ball angling away just outside off, 144ks, Marsh didn't move his front foot much and tried to defend straight. Beaten on the outside edge
Nowhere short but that's pulled with ease. 145ks on a length at leg, Marsh takes a small stride forward, stays slightly open, and pulls from top-of-pad height over square leg
Length on leg, Pooran waits before flicking to square leg
Back of length outside off, 139ks, cut softly to cover point
Hard length on leg, flicked to square leg
Touch back of length on off, defended to the bowler's right and Archer completes an excellent maiden. He has a jovial word with Pooran
Back of length, beats the flick and hits him around the forearm before going off side
Goes into the pitch and that jumps off the pitch. 148ks. Pooran jumps and gets his bat down while swaying back

Nearly takes the outside edge. Seam points slightly towards first slip, goes down at 148ks to hit a back of length and goes over off. Pooran keeps his bat close to his chest after shaping to guide it behind point
Full around off, defended to cover
Fullish length ball on leg, flicked to square leg. May have just been pad. 148ks
Full on off, 144ks, punched defensively to mid-on
Fullish length ball just outside off, 146ks, driven off the inside-half of the bat to the bowler
Fullish on off, defended towards cover. 148ks
Back of length on leg, 139ks, beats the pull and deflects to point
Pulled with disdain! Not that short, Marsh stays upright and hits it from under the top of the thigh through midwicket
Length on leg, defended to the bowler
Pitched up on leg, flicked through midwicket with ease. Archer missed his length just a bit
Short ball at 151ks! Lands just down leg and Pooran ducks

Top edge goes in the sky, swirls around for a while. Jurel pops his cap off, takes a couple of steps back, settles underneath and takes it with fingers pointing up. 147ks back of length ball rises at pace to waist-height. Markram looks to flick it off the back foot, diagonal bat went down and then up. Archer waits before celebrating
Length on middle and leg, worked to mid-on
Short over leg, 139ks, Markram shrugs his left shoulder forward to let it pass
Pitched up on leg, 146ks, flicked to mid-on
Full on middle and leg, defended to mid-on
Length on middle, defended towards midwicket
Angles away and beats bat. Hard length lands around leg and goes away off the pitch to square Markram up as he tries to defend straight, off the back foot
Big sound as the ball passed bat and it's given. Pant goes big again but with a slog sweep to a fullish length ball outside off. It rises and goes off a thin edge to the keeper. 143ks.
Back of length on leg, dances down and under-edges a pull to wide mid-on. 147ks
Dances down and looks to go over extra cover to a shortish ball. Like he does in Tests. Misses this time
Length just outside off, punched towards cover

Badoni gone by the sub-fielder! Sent upstairs, looked out. Yeah, Badoni not even in the frame as Ravi ran in from midwicket and under-armed it at the striker's. Was a length ball on leg, Badoni looked to defend it straight. Ball went off the inside edge to the leg side. Badoni ran half-way on the edge of the off-side of the pitch, Marsh was on the other side signaling 'there's no run there'. Badoni went back, Ravi came in and threw it from the short-leg area
Length around off, guided off an angled bat face towards backward point
Even better. Archer wants to bring it in off a full length, doesn't get any shape and Marsh drives it over the bowler from just outside off.
Crashed through cover. Archer offering width on the 146ks full ball, Marsh gets forward and lunges on one knee and drives with the bat nearly hitting his back in follow-through
Pitched up on off, Marsh gets upright and drives hard to mid-off. 146ks
And Archer on the money. Inswinging yorker on leg at 143ks, Marsh has to slide his front leg out before jamming the ball straight
